questions.q: Where do you see naturalism showing up in your school or classes?
questions.answer: For example: in science, math and tech classes, where only what can be observed counts as real. It can go deeper too, like the idea that meaning only comes from science.

questions.q: If only what you can sense is real, where do justice and love come from?
questions.answer: Naturalism can't really say. You can't taste or touch justice or love, yet we know they're real, and that points beyond nature to a Creator God.

questions.q: Why would someone who rejects God still want to give kids clean water?
questions.answer: Because they still feel a real pull toward justice and love, even though naturalism can't explain it. The lesson says that pull points to a Creator beyond the natural world.
